CUSTOMER COMPLAINT REPORT
Complaint ID: CMP-2026-0847
Date: August 12, 2026
Source: Phone Call
Customer Name: Sarah Mitchell
Company: Greenfield Pharmacy
Product: Amoxicillin 500mg Capsules
Batch / Lot Number: AMX-2026-B147
Manufacturing Date: March 2026
Expiry Date: March 2028
Quantity Affected: 120 capsules (2 bottles)
Type: Product Defect

Upon opening a sealed bottle, several capsules were stuck together and discolored yellowish-brown. The outer seal was intact, but the inner foil barrier appeared compromised. Affected capsules were not administered.

Supporting evidence includes photos and a shipping receipt indicating an ambient temperature excursion. The customer requested a replacement and an investigation into cold-chain shipping integrity.
